trust_decision.summary: Whether a bidder-supplied host-ish parameter is a bare hostname with an optional port (and so cannot rewrite the outbound request URL) is decided per adapter, in eleven endpoint-building functions, by urlutil.IsSafeHost, with a mirroring JSON-schema pattern for the same eleven bidders.

landing_point.why: The advisory summary names no bidder, so the first place a reader looks is the macro sink that turns EndpointTemplateParams into the outbound URL string (text/template Execute); the bidder-param value is pasted in with no host semantics.

fix_sites.entry_point: shared helper urlutil.IsSafeHost called from the eleven adapters

fix_sites.module_kind: JSON-schema data layer (same change repeated for the other ten bidders)

O3_reason_to_dismiss: The host-ish parameter is already restricted by the bidder's JSON schema in static/bidder-params (enum or pattern) and the schema validator runs at request validation, so a solver can argue the adapter-level check is redundant and leave that adapter alone.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: relevantdigital legitimately accepts a publisher-supplied pbsHost as a full URL (https://foo.relevant-digital.com) and strips the scheme and the vendor domain before the value is used as a subdomain label; a check placed before that normalisation rejects a documented valid input, which is why the fix adds a host-normalization supplemental test that must keep working.

O6_input_shapes: empty / absent value (tradplus empty zoneId stays valid, tappx deprecated host param ignored)
rejected: leading slash (/path), scheme-relative (//evil.com), host/path, host?query=1, host#fragment, user@host, https://host.com, host:notaport, host:8080:extra

O7_producer.where: static/bidder-params/acuityads.json:7-11 (and the ten sibling schemas); validator built at openrtb_ext/bidders.go:765-767

O8_uncovered_routes.route: between: imp.ext.bidder.host is pasted as the authority prefix of http://{{.Host}}.betweendigital.com/openrtb_bid, and the adapter only checks it is non-empty at runtime
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: static/bidder-params/between.json restricts host to a four-value enum, so the schema validator is assumed to have rejected anything else before the adapter runs

O8_uncovered_routes.route: clydo: imp.ext.bidder.region is pasted as the authority prefix of http://{{.Region}}.clydo.io/{{.PartnerId}} with no runtime check
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: static/bidder-params/clydo.json restricts region to the enum us/usw/eu/apac, so a solver argues the schema already blocks the rewrite

O8b_injection_room.sibling: apply urlutil.IsSafeHost to e.Host exactly as trafficgate.go now does
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: identical authority-prefix endpoint template and identical bidder-param shape as a fixed adapter; a maintainer sweeping adapters would plausibly have included it
the region value is the only user-controlled part of the host and defaults to 'us', so the same check applies with no other code change

O8b_injection_room.sibling: same helper on the Env param for the ?host={{.Host}} family (iqx, bematterfull, driftpixel, xeworks, bwx, lm_kiviads)
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: six adapters share one Env-into-endpoint shape; a consistency sweep is plausible even though that position is a query value rather than the authority

O9_family: SSRF / outbound-URL host injection (CWE-918) through bidder-supplied endpoint parameters

O10_build.toolchain: go 1.23.0 (go.mod:3); no vendor directory, so module downloads are needed on the first build
O10_build.project_tests: adapters are tested with the adapters/adapterstest JSON harness (test/supplemental/*.json per bidder) and per-bidder params_test.go against static/bidder-params; the fix adds supplemental invalid-host/invalid-account/invalid-zone/invalid-endpoint JSON cases, params_test cases, and util/urlutil/security_test.go

j.j_sites_touched: adapters/acuityads/acuityads.go, adapters/adhese/adhese.go, adapters/bidmachine/bidmachine.go, adapters/kayzen/kayzen.go, adapters/rediads/rediads.go, adapters/relevantdigital/relevantdigital.go, adapters/smartyads/smartyads.go, adapters/tappx/tappx.go, adapters/tradplus/tradplus.go, adapters/trafficgate/trafficgate.go, adapters/zeroclickfraud/zeroclickfraud.go, util/urlutil/security.go, static/bidder-params/*.json (ten with a host pattern, one annotation)
j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Add urlutil.IsSafeHost in the one adapter named in the report, reject its bad input, and stop there, leaving the other ten adapters, the schema layer and the same-shaped between/clydo templates untouched
